title: a11y find: MFC deep-descendant grandchildren via EnumChildWindows
desc: HTS/MFC apps expose empty UIA tree below top frame; controls live 3-4 levels under custom container classes. FindChildByPattern now recurses via Win32 EnumChildWindows as final fallback (after MDIClient/direct-children layers) so grap like '*Hero*/Form1101/*StockCode*' reaches grandchildren.
steps: grap child segment X/Y/Z: each segment becomes a FindChildByPattern call against the previous hwnd
Layer 3 EnumChildWindows full subtree recurse -- catches MFC 3+ depth controls the prior layers missed
Returns first pattern match in enumeration order
Use '[cls] title cid=N hwnd=H WxH' search key; PatternMatcher.TokenMatchAny matches title + key
Usage example: wkappbot a11y find '*Hero*/MDIClient/Form1101/*StockCode*' reaches MFC grandchildren that prior 2-layer logic missed

[v6.2+ SIMPLE PATH] For top-level MDI panel discovery, simple wildcard 'a11y find *panel-title*' now works -- FindWindows simple-pattern path auto-falls-back to MDI child enumeration. This skill's grap-chain layer (Parent/MDIClient/Form1101/*StockCode*) is still required for drilling INTO MFC grandchildren via Win32 EnumChildWindows; simple fallback covers top-level MDI Window elements only.

STOP-EARLY PATTERN: grap path can target any intermediate window in the hierarchy -- you do NOT need to reach a leaf field. '*App*/MDIClient/Form1101' returns the Form1101 container hwnd directly. Use this when you need the container window itself (screenshot, click-region, child enumeration) rather than a specific element inside it. Combining with cls glob: '{cls:*Form*}' or '{proc:App}#MDIClient/MyPanel' stops at the panel. This avoids brittle deep paths when the container is the actual target.
